name: CredentialVerify

parameters.help_en:
The credential type. Valid values:

01: personal card and certificate
02: business scenario
03: enterprise qualification
parameters.help_zh:
凭证类型：

01：个人卡证类
02：经营场景类
03：企业资质类
parameters.name: cred_type

parameters.help_en:
The credential name. Valid values:

01: personal card and certificate
0101: ID card
0102: bank card
0104: teacher qualification certificate
0107: student ID card
02: business scenario
0201: storefront photo
0202: counter photo
0203: scene photo
03: enterprise qualification
0301: business license
parameters.help_zh:
01：个人卡证类
0101：身份证
0102：银行卡
0104：教师资格证
0107：学生证
02：经营场景类
0201：门头照
0202：柜台照
0203：场景照
03：企业资质类
0301：工商营业执照
parameters.name: cred_name

parameters.help_en: The image URL. Specify either imageUrl or imageContext
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded image. Specify either imageUrl or imageContext
parameters.name: image_context

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable optical character recognition (OCR). Valid values:

0: Disabled.
1: Enabled.

You can set isOCR to 1 only when CredType is set to 01
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启OCR识别。

0：否
1：是

仅当CredType取值01时，isOCR可设置为1
parameters.name: is_ocr

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable authoritative verification. Valid values:

0: Disabled.
1: Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启权威认证

****0****：否
1：是
parameters.name: is_check

parameters.help_en: The merchant ID. This parameter is required when CredName is set to 02
parameters.help_zh: 商户编号。****CredName****取值02时，此字段需要输入
parameters.name: merchant_id

parameters.help_en:
The call mode. Valid values:

ANTI_FAKE_CHECK: image anti-forgery detection.

ANTI_FAKE_VL: image anti-forgery detection and semantic understanding.

IMAGE_VL_COG: image semantic understanding.

Default value: ANTI_FAKE_CHECK.

ProductCode can be set to ANTI_FAKE_VL or IMAGE_VL_COG only when CredType is set to 02
parameters.help_zh:
调用模式：

ANTI_FAKE_CHECK:  图片防伪检测

ANTI_FAKE_VL:  图片防伪检测及语义理解

IMAGE_VL_COG：图片语义理解

默认取值 ANTI_FAKE_CHECK

当且仅当CredType取值02时，ProductCode才能取值为ANTI_FAKE_VL或者IMAGE_VL_COG
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
The method to obtain the prompt for image semantic understanding. Valid values:

DEFAULT: system default.

CUSTOM: custom.

Note: This parameter is required when ProductCode is set to ANTI_FAKE_VL or IMAGE_VL_COG
parameters.help_zh:
图片语义理解prompt获取方式：

DEFAULT：系统默认

CUSTOM：客户自定义

说明：当ProductCode取值ANTI_FAKE_VL或者IMAGE_VL_COG时，此项参数必传
parameters.name: prompt_model

parameters.help_en:
The custom prompt content for image semantic understanding.

This parameter is required when PromptModel is set to CUSTOM
parameters.help_zh:
图片语义理解，客户自定义prompt内容。

当PromptModel取值CUSTOM，此项必输
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required when PromptModel is set to DEFAULT
parameters.name: merchant_detail

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate failure
Code.description_zh: 返回码：200为成功，其他为失败

MaterialInfo.description_en: The additional information in JSON format

Result.description_en:
The risk result. Valid values:

0: Low risk.
1: High risk.
2: Suspicious
Result.description_zh:
风险结果：

0：低风险。
1：高风险。
****2****：可疑

RiskTag.description_en:
The risk tags, separated by commas (,). Valid values:

PS: image manipulation.
SCREEN_PHOTO: screen recapture.
SCREENSHOT: screenshot.
WATERMARK: watermark.
COLOR_PRINT: color print copy.
WEB_IMAGE: web image.
SAME_FACE: similar face.
SAME_BACKGROUND: similar background
RiskTag.description_zh:
风险标签，多个标签用半角逗号（,）隔开，包括：

PS：图片PS。
SCREEN_PHOTO：屏幕翻拍。
SCREENSHOT：屏幕截屏。
WATERMARK：水印。
COLOR_PRINT：彩打复印。
WEB_IMAGE:  网络照片。
SAME_FACE：人脸相似。
SAME_BACKGROUND：背景相似

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the Qwen interpretation is successful. Valid values:

true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
通义千问解释成功标识

true：成功

false：失败
